extracted.intended_audience: researchers considering applying for European Research Council (ERC) grants
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance on ERC funding schemes, eligibility and preparatory resources for researchers preparing applications to ERC Starting, Consolidator, Advanced, Synergy and Proof of Concept grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Starting Grants eligibility and expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: These grants are for researchers with 2-7 years of experience since the completion of their PhD, a scientific track record showing great promise and an excellent research proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audience: early-career researchers 2–7 years post-PhD. Emphasises both a promising scientific track record and an excellent research proposal as expectations for applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Consolidator Grants eligibility and expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: These grants are for researchers with 7-12 years of experience since completion of PhD, a scientific track record showing great promise and an excellent research proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audience: mid-career researchers 7–12 years post-PhD. Requires a scientific track record showing great promise and an excellent research proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Advanced Grants eligibility and expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: These grants are for active researchers with a track-record of significant research achievements in the last 10 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audience: senior/established researchers. The key evaluative element is a demonstrable track record of significant research achievements within the previous decade.

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Proof of Concept eligibility and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: These grants are for researchers who have already received an ERC grant for their frontier research project and now want to explore the commercial or societal potential of it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility requires prior ERC funding; purpose is to enable exploration of commercial or societal exploitation of earlier ERC-funded frontier research.

rubrics_metrics.name: ERC Synergy Grants composition and aim
rubrics_metrics.description: These grants are for two to maximum four researchers working together and bringing different skills and resources to tackle ambitious research problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Team-based award: consortia of 2–4 PIs. Emphasis on complementary skills/resources and capacity to address ambitious, high-risk/high-gain problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use national contact points for application support
rubrics_metrics.description: National contact points ... are designated to help applicants out in their own countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is one national contact point in every EU and Associated Country (and some countries outside Europe). Applicants are advised to contact these local advisers early for application-specific help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult key documents (Work Programme and Information for Applicants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents and publications ... like the Work Programme and the Information for Applicants. These highlight the specifics of the calls every year, as well as providing some useful information to think about before you embark on the process itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should refer to the current Work Programme and Information for Applicants for call-specific rules, eligibility details, submission requirements and practical guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-EU researcher considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: For non EU-researchers: If you are a researcher from outside the EU and you wish to apply check out some of the things you should consider.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-EU applicants should review additional considerations and possible constraints that may affect their application or eligibility (the page points to further information specific to non-EU researchers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ERC explanatory videos and classes
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step video and ERC Classes: This series of 5 explanatory videos will give you concrete information about the ERC application process, including frequently made mistakes, tips and rumours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Watch the step-by-step introductory video and the ERC Classes series to learn practical tips, common mistakes to avoid and procedural details for the application process.
